instruction:
Use the Abaqus/CAE GUI to build a contact analysis assembly from scratch:

1. Part-1 (Block):
   - 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion
   - 20 mm x 20 mm rectangle, extruded to height 30 mm

2. Part-2 (Plate):
   - 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion
   - 100 mm x 100 mm rectangle, extruded to height 5 mm

3. Property:
   - Material Steel: E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
   - Assign the same material to both parts

4. Assembly:
   - Instance both parts
   - Use Constraint > Coincident Point to align the center of the block bottom face with the center of the plate top face
   - Place the block above the plate in natural contact (no penetration)

5. Step:
   - Static, General, Nlgeom = ON

6. Interaction (key GUI operations):
   - Create Surface-to-Surface Contact (Standard)
   - Master surface: plate top face
   - Slave surface: block bottom face
   - Contact property: Frictionless, Hard Contact

7. Load:
   - Fully fix the bottom face of the plate (Encastre)
   - Apply Pressure = 10 MPa downward on the top face of the block

8. Mesh:
   - Block: C3D8R, seed 3 mm
   - Plate: C3D8R, seed 5 mm

9. Job: Create Job-Contact and submit for solving.

10. Visualization:
   - Review contact pressure CPRESS
   - Review Mises stress

11. Save:
   - Model: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.cae
   - Results: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.odb
